headline: A pleasant, warming weekend gives way to a fast-moving cold front Sunday afternoon into early Monday with a burst of rain and gusty winds, then dry, cool weather before temperatures climb well above normal late next week.

sections.title: Today & Tonight
sections.text: Gusts of 15 to 25 mph across the Charlotte area, Piedmont and Upstate ease through the morning, then another round of 15 to 20 mph gusts picks up this afternoon before dying down this evening. Skies turn mostly sunny and highs rebound to near or slightly above normal. In the mountains, gusts up to about 35 mph linger at higher elevations, especially in the northern North Carolina mountains.

sections.title: Short Term
sections.text: Sunday is a few degrees warmer before a strong cold front sweeps through Sunday afternoon into Sunday night, possibly with heavy rain for a time late Sunday afternoon and evening, but flooding looks unlikely because the front is moving fast. Most guidance gives 0.3 to 1.25 inches over the western half of the region (over an inch mainly along the Blue Ridge escarpment) and less than half an inch in the eastern areas, including the Charlotte area. There is little instability but strong winds aloft, so a low-end severe storm threat exists; the main concern is gusty winds Sunday afternoon into early Monday, over 30 mph in lower areas and 40 to 50 mph in the higher elevations, where a Wind Advisory may be needed. Dry, cool high pressure moves back in Monday.

sections.title: Long Term
sections.text: Dry, quiet weather lingers through the middle of the week, then temperatures warm to well above normal by the end of the week. Another storm system and cold front could bring rain Friday into Saturday, with chances increasing in the latest forecast, and warmer temperatures make it likely that it will be all rain.

watch_for: Gusty winds Sunday afternoon into early Monday, with a possible Wind Advisory for the mountains
Brief heavy rain and a low-end chance of damaging storm gusts Sunday afternoon and evening
Rain chances with the next system Friday into Saturday
confidence: Forecasters are confident in the weekend warm-up and a fast-moving front Sunday into early Monday, with some uncertainty in rain totals and wind strength, and growing but still moderate confidence in rain late next week.
